proposal.measures: mu^2 statistic: mean over 8 equal blocks of e of the squared block means
proposal.rationale: the planted half-cosine drift moves every local block mean of the residual far outside the clean process's block-mean scatter, so the mu^2 statistic (the squared local level of e) rises by an order of magnitude

rationale: Level-bias: a constant level offset the incumbent misses.  A TRUE constant is absorbed by the mean-predictor incumbent (e is centered by construction), so the admissible design is the low-frequency limit: a half-cosine drift over the series, cos(pi*t/T) at 0.7 * sd(clean ch0) on channel 0 — zero net mean shift over the window (the DC part is absorbed) but a level that sweeps from +0.7 sd to -0.7 sd, so no local window of the residual sits at the global mean.  The witness is the mu^2 statistic: block means of e are +-0.6 sd on the planted member against a ~0.1 sd clean floor, an order-of-magnitude shift; the marginal std perturbation is ~11% (gate 3) and the band-24/lag-3/bilinear probes see nothing (gate 2).
